method: Headless Chromium with Playwright, isolated durable local host directory, synthetic CEO login, actual UI proposal/approval/change/cancellation/termination actions, existing realtime client and R3F character inspection. Native finite-response completion and CDP network timing were observed without capturing payload bodies. Product source stayed unchanged throughout the run.
scope: Isolated durable local recruitment with synthetic CEO login and explicit mock assessments; no provider credential or paid call.

checks.name: Unauthenticated office exposes login without employee records or client authority
CEO session uses HttpOnly SameSite cookie and password is absent from UI/browser storage
Initial authoritative snapshot contains only dedicated Manager and no recruited employees
Proposal creation does not activate a candidate
Material revision preserves v1 and requires renewed exact-version approval
Approved candidate enters on existing Stickman with shared carried file but no employee entry
Actual host mock assessment activates one explicitly simulated employee only after approved checks
Activation preserves character resources and routes to an unoccupied assigned workstation
Historical versions and approvals remain inspectable
Exact employee selection and camera focus preserve animation
Manager stays dedicated calm and never receives a headband
Mandatory capability failure records evidence and sends candidate toward exit without active access
Host-confirmed departure removes candidate instead of retaining an employee
Technical failure remains pending with diagnostics and no fabricated skills rejection
Retry retains employee identity and history without duplicate employee or grants
Refresh restores persisted recruitment and employee identity without replaying jobs
Realtime resynchronization preserves stable business identities
Forged actor fields and privileged host files remain rejected
A simulated employee cannot invoke the real provider runtime
Candidates and active employees remain separate with accessible status labels
Idle synchronization does not poll or produce business updates every frame
Shared canonical GLBs are requested once per page lifecycle
Public state excludes credentials, secret identifiers and host paths
Open-top overview and camera reset remain available
CEO cancellation releases a paused interview without activating the candidate
Interrupted arrival reverses safely and removes the cancelled candidate without assessment or employee creation
CEO termination retains identity, proposal and approved history with an explicit audit event
Terminated employee leaves the active scene and cannot reappear as a candidate
Terminated employee operational requests remain denied
A subsequent approved hire reuses the freed workstation without overlapping the terminated employee
Replacement retains the former employee history and creates exactly one new active identity
Replacement reuses cached canonical geometry and introduces no extra GLB requests
No console errors or unexpected failed browser requests
Product source remained stable during acceptance

expectedPageReloadAborts.policy: Only exact in-flight request objects recorded immediately before explicit page reload were eligible for teardown classification. No general ERR_ABORTED exclusion was used.

visualInspection: Fresh arrival screenshot shows the canonical candidate carrying the shared folder at handR, with candidate-only selection and an explicit simulation label.
Fresh replacement-workstation screenshot shows one canonical worker seated at the freed supplied desk; the former employee remains terminated in history and has no active scene controls.
Fresh overview screenshot retains the open-top office, visible corridors, separate Manager and candidate markers, and the active worker at its desk.
Existing one-shot camera focus can crop a moving candidate after focus; it does not change navigation or business state.
screenshotStorage: Ignored test-results directory; local validation evidence, not runtime assets.
limitations: Explicit mock capabilities do not demonstrate live AI employee competence.
No real provider credential or paid request was used.
Local cookie authentication and file persistence are not a deployed multi-tenant service.
Browser refresh restores canonical positions; in-flight interpolation is presentation-only.
No hardware FPS claim; this validates idle command behavior and shared loading, not a 100-agent performance benchmark.
Interview speech/lip synchronization is not implemented; actual questions, evidence and outcomes are accessible in the recruitment file.
